{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fitted ribbed knit top, slim cut with a boat neckline, long sleeves, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D1F2E), fine merino wool
Midi skirt, softly A-line, falling just below the knee, black (#1C1C1E), crepe with a subtle drape
Ankle boots, slim block heel about 5 cm, almond toe, black (#111111), smooth leather
Shoulder bag, small structured shape with a short chain strap, black (#1C1C1E), leather
Drop earrings, small, polished gold (#C9A24B), metal
Thin leather belt, narrow, worn at the waist over the knit, black (#1C1C1E), leather
Light wool coat, straight cut, knee length, camel (#B98A5A), brushed wool

This outfit suits a neat date in a restaurant: the refined knit with a skirt and ankle boots sits right in the neat band without feeling stiff. The burgundy brings warmth and a romantic note for an autumn evening, while the black skirt and boots keep the look clean and grounded. Under artificial restaurant lighting the rich colour looks deep and flattering, and the gold earrings add a soft glow near the face. The camel coat keeps her comfortable on the way there and is easy to hand over at the cloakroom."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2111,"output_tokens":431},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
